title: Add Scroll to top feature in comments view

timeline.message: scroll to top of comments section feature implemented
timeline.author: Kat Allen

timeline.body: The `scrollToTopButton` is not referenced anywhere other than the `initViews` method. You should remove the field and make it a local variable instead.
A `FloatingActionButton` with an upward-facing arrow icon would be a better choice for this purpose. Also, the button could be hidden if the scroll position is already at the top of the list.
